name: Slug Generator
summary: Turn any title into a clean, URL-friendly slug — locally in your browser.
description: Convert headings and titles into SEO-friendly slugs. Strips punctuation and accents, collapses spaces, and lets you pick the separator. Everything runs on your device.

faqs.question: What is a slug?
faqs.answer: A slug is the URL-friendly part of a web address, usually lowercase words joined by hyphens, like why-forge-runs-in-your-browser.

faqs.question: Does it remove accents?
faqs.answer: In ASCII-only mode it transliterates accents (é becomes e). Turn that off to keep unicode letters.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Slug generation runs entirely in your browser.
